prerequisites: Matching firmware-owned setup-bluetooth v1 pin and snapshots in app and Workshop
Pinned Python environment with jsonschema and local signed synthetic fixtures

steps.action: Record the checkout revisions, dirty source hashes, procedure digest and runner version.
steps.expect: The attempt identifies the exact contract and its setup-transfer, credential and storage dependencies.

steps.action: Run each checkout's tools/verify_setup_bluetooth.py with Python -B.
steps.expect: The same GATT service interfaces and compatible, rejected and malformed exchanges pass against the frozen bytes on all three checkouts.

steps.action: Run the app host tests test_setup_bluetooth_contract.py and test_runtime_interface_audit.py with unittest discovery.
steps.expect: Missing services, subscriptions or access, stale connections, wrong CORE credentials, replay and interrupted storage follow their specified outcomes. First discovery expires at exactly 300000 ms.

steps.action: Save the exit codes, case counts, source digests and failures with this attempt. Retain each retry separately.
steps.expect: A pass requires all steps. A missing prerequisite or interrupted runner leaves the attempt incomplete.

required_evidence: Automatic runner output for each checkout
Host fixture outcomes and measured coverage
physical_observations: No physical observations in this procedure. C8.4/C8.8 integration supplies matching app and role builds and a separate Workshop device procedure.
